title: Memory
summary: Ava looks up what she knows about you and shows where it came from.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Search what you know about the owner: notes in your notebook and past messages across channels. Returns sources you can cite. Use a few specific keywords (names, topics, places); fewer words find more.

query.description: A few keywords to search for (names, topics, places). Spelling variants and synonyms are matched for you

channel.description: Only what was said on this channel, e.g. when the owner asks what they told you on Telegram
